messages.subject: Pennington Industries v Tregarth Bearings - Claim issued (BL-2025-000418)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Tindale,

Proceedings have been issued in the Circuit Commercial Court, claim number BL-2025-000418. By way of service, we attach the issued Particulars of Claim. The Schedule of Loss has been served under separate cover.

We look forward to receiving your client's Defence in due course.

Yours faithfully,
Tom Gallagher
Whitfield Carter LLP

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
